metadata.name: All Eyes
metadata.description: In the middle of his exploration, Phetta became aware that he was being observed. This was a new experience for him since he was used to the probing eyes of the creatures who inhabit the realm of the Phettaverse. Nonetheless... There is a fresh set of eyes on the scene... They keep an eye on him from every aspect, keeping track of every move he makes. Have his case files been discovered? Are they paying attention right now? A wave of worry sweeps over him, but he remains fascinated, maintaining his position, and delighted that others are interested in his efforts.

metadata.name: Business Frog Manager
metadata.description:
The Business Frog's debut appearance... As the frog's influence grows, Phetta begins to feel the need to improve his marketing skills and share his experiences with others. Emotionull's genuine pal Crypto Joe is the inspiration for Business Frog, although if the attorneys ask that's not true. This frog appears to be looking out for Phetta's best interests... It's time for Phetta to act like he's a big-time star! Ya BIG TIME now PHETTA, WAKE UP!

Phetta's world and my own personal experiences are intertwined in this composition. When it comes to the wider picture of communicating my inner thoughts and ideas, I prefer to focus on the art because, as an artist, I truly am just producing what I love. Thank you to the wonderful people in my life who continue to push me and my artistic journey forward.

metadata.name: Dream-State Kart World
metadata.description:
The Phettaverse’s abilities have created a new universe, and Phetta is the lucky one to get to see it for the first time. TV Man, of course, is there to join in the fun! To some extent, this universe is intertwined with the Mega Computer mind that created the land’s textures. Every time a new area is formed in the Phettaverse, there appear to be more mysteries and secrets to be unearthed. With this recent one, it’s a playable dream embedded within the universe. Not all adventures lead to scary ends, in the Phettaverse, they often lead to exciting new stories and activities to partake in. This place has a mysterious, strange, and ethereal aura to it. Crowds of these alien-like creatures appear to be supporting Phetta! I don’t know how long they’ve been there. Are they harmful, or are they just here to attract? Despite their strange appearance, they appear to be filled with a lot of power. The glowing eyes and earrings could possibly be allowing the stands to float in this universe. Are they the owners of this world?

The first playable game NFT within the Phettaverse collection as well!
